title: introduce-prefer-schema-v1-rewrite-shim-for-typed-responses-and-streaming
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: We need a low-risk path to roll out the v1 request/response schema without breaking existing OpenAI-compatible clients. This PR implements an opt-in header (Prefer-Schema-Version: 1) that triggers a server-side rewrite shim for outgoing responses and streaming chunks so that callers who opt in get the typed/structured v1 output while others remain on legacy behavior. The shim covers: 1) streaming delta normalization (stable event shapes across chunk boundaries), 2) function/tool call envelope translation (v0->v1 mapping for name/arguments), 3) typed 'choices' vs generic 'outputs' mapping, and 4) backwards-safe fallbacks for missing fields. Implementation notes: the shim lives behind a feature gate and a beta header, it is applied in the API compatibility middleware layer so it works for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private, and it emits telemetry markers for rollout metrics. Checklist: - [x] add Accept/Prefer header handling and tests - [x] implement streaming chunk rewriter with idempotent buffers - [x] map legacy function call shapes to v1 typed envelope - [x] add integration tests for SDKs (python/typescript) - [x] add rollout feature flag and telemetry events - [x] update compatibility docs and release notes Risks/Notes: - There is a small perf tax for enabled requests due to on-path rewriting; telemetry suggests ~2-4% p99 latency shift for long-running streams. - This is an opt-in beta; we will collect errors and schema validation failures for 2 weeks before promoting. Related: Linear ENG-1973, ENG-2011, and doc task PM-122. See discussion thread https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1973/prefer-schema-v1-beta for rollout plan.

review_comments: Ben Thorne: Overall looks good. Two requests: add an explicit opt-out telemetry marker and ensure the rewriter is deterministic across retries.
Aisha Kumar: Added telemetry markers 'compat.v1.opt_in' and 'compat.v1.rewrite_applied'; rewriter now tags chunks with a monotonic sequence id to ensure idempotency.
Elena Martins: Found a case where an incomplete function_call.arguments JSON would break the mapper; suggest defensive parsing.
Aisha Kumar: Defensive parse added, falls back to raw string in the v1.arguments field and emits a validation metric when parsing fails.
Santiago Rios: Can we gate the streaming rewriter behind a separate flag so we can enable response rewrites and streaming independently?
Aisha Kumar: Refactored to support two flags: 'compat.schema_v1_response' and 'compat.schema_v1_streaming'. Default both false; header still controls immediate opt-in for testing.
merge_commit_message: squash: opt-in Prefer-Schema-Version:1 rewrite shim for typed responses and stable streaming
release_notes: Beta: add Prefer-Schema-Version header to opt into v1 typed response shapes and stable streaming chunk format. Opt-in only; no breaking changes for clients that do not send the header. Monitor compat.v1.* telemetry during rollout.
notes: This PR is a compatibility shim and is intentionally conservative. Next steps include a controlled canary, prometheus dashboards for compat.v1.* metrics, and SDK updates to expose the header in convenience helpers. We will run a 2-week evaluation window before considering defaulting traffic to schema v1.
